speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) since January 2021, what is the number of foreign domestic workers who have had their entry approval postponed due to the border restrictions; (b) how long is the waiting time before an entry approval can be given; and (c) whether the Ministry will allow the entry of these workers on an exception basis for families with a member who is delivering a baby soon, or an elderly who is immobile or with disabilities needing urgent care-giver support.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Among the travellers and MDWs coming from these countries, we found a significant number who were COVID-19-positive when they arrived.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: They posed a transmission risk to our frontline workers at our checkpoints and at Stay-Home Notice (SHN) facilities and had to be cared for under our healthcare system.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Hence, the Government has had to restrict the numbers entering from high incidence countries.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Since May, MOM could only approve a small number of MDWs for entry every week.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: With a much smaller number allowed to enter, MOM prioritised the entry of MDWs for families with very challenging caregiving needs.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: But there are also more employers who are still waiting to submit their entry applications and we hope that the COVID-19 situation in the region improves so that we can approve more to enter.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: In the meantime, we are not waiting passively for the regional situation to improve.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: And this is to implement additional safe management measures in the MDW's home country before they enter Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Our priority is to ensure that the risk of COVID-19 importation is well managed so as to protect our public health as well as the safety of families where the MDWs are deployed to.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Some prospective MDW employers may have to consider other arrangements until the regional COVID-19 situation improves.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Employers may also wish to consider if using the cleaning services of providers under the Household Services Scheme may be of some help.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: We will continue to monitor the situation closely but rest assured we will do our best to facilitate the entry of MDWs in a safe manner.
